description: Drive a Tailscale node and its tailnet through the CLI and the control-plane API
name: io.github.tailscale-mcp/tailscale-mcp

environmentVariables.description: A control-plane API access token. One of this, the OAuth client pair, or the OAuth JWT file is needed for the tailnet tools; without any of them only the local tools are offered.
environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: An OAuth client id, used with TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET when there is no API access token.
environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: The OAuth client secret that goes with TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.
environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: The tailnet the control-plane tools act on. Without it they act on the one the credential belongs to.
environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_TAILNET

environmentVariables.description: Which tools are offered: minimal, core or full.
environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_MCP_PRESET

environmentVariables.description: Offer the tools that change something. Read-only without it.
environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: Offer the tools that remove or sever something. Implies the write tier.
environmentVariables.name: TAILSCALE_MCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE

title: Tailscale
